description: For an expansion of an arithmetic structure by the fresh constant, the expanded Peano axioms hold under full semantics exactly when the arithmetic reduct satisfies Robinson arithmetic and induction for all subsets.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.expanded_models_iff.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.expandedLanguage.Structure M]
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.expansionMap.IsExpansionOn M] :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.FullModels M
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.expandedPeanoTheory ↔
    M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.FullSubsetInduction M
